tools.name: calculate_business_days
tools.description: Calculate exact business days between two calendar dates (excluding weekends and optional holidays) OR add/subtract business days to compute an exact deadline date.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Compute exact monthly mortgage payment, total interest, total cost, payoff acceleration from extra monthly payments, and yearly amortization summary.

tools.name: calculate_compound_interest
tools.description: Calculate exact compound interest final balance, effective APY, total contributions, and growth milestones with optional monthly contributions.

tools.name: calculate_vat
tools.description: Add VAT to a net price or extract the exact net base and VAT amount from a VAT-inclusive gross price rounded cleanly to 2 decimal places.

tools.name: calculate_spain_net_salary
